integrity: Explicit polynomial identities, local residue counts and density sieve are supplied; no external independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Proves squarefree noninjectivity only for an explicit positive-density even-base family, not for every integer base; finite verifications supplement a full proof. An unindexed equivalent construction remains a possible bibliographic risk.
title: Even-base squarefree digit-sum collisions of positive density
